description: Broad amber-yellow tooth, split from crown to root. Even an Emberjaw loses one on the wrong kind of bone.
lore: It split crown to root, and it split from closing, not from being struck. A tooth that comes apart the long way did it to itself, biting down on something that would not open.

Which is why there is a list, and the list is the whole conversation every time one of these crosses a counter. [[monsters/armor_tusker|Ironhide]]'s plates. The black glass out of the volcano. Whatever it is a [[monsters/lava_salamander_2|Palemaw]] keeps working on ground where nothing else will feed. Three, and everyone agrees on the three, and then the counting runs on a beat too long, and somebody buys the fang, and the talk goes somewhere else.
Thirty gold. Amber ivory takes a shine like nothing else in the trade, and half the buyers do not care about any of the above, which is a mercy on the ones who do.
gm_notes: A list of three that everyone can feel has a fourth entry. Nobody names it and the record must not; the pause is the content.
